# Amenities

- [Home](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/)
- Amenities

Hard Work Pays Off

Home Away From Home

A Breath of Fresh Air

Exclusive Experiences Curated For You

Relax, We've Got You

At Foundry Lofts, we strive to provide our residents with the ultimate living experience, which is why we offer an extensive list of amenities that cater to their needs. Live with unparalleled comfort and convenience and schedule a tour of Foundry Lofts today!

![Fitness center](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Foundry-lofts-amenities-6.jpg)

## Hard Work Pays Off

You can workout or work on coursework when it fits your schedule. Located conveniently on-site, our useful amenities provide space for you to focus and work toward your goals.

- 24/7  Fitness Center
- Work & Study Lounges
- Computer Lab

![Furnished apartment living space](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Foundry-lofts-amenities-5.jpg)

## Home Away From Home

Forget cramped, generic dorm rooms! Our modern living spaces offer residents an inviting and comfortable place to call home.

- Fully Furnished
- Private & Shared Bedroom Options
- TVs In Every Unit
- Closets In Every Room
- FOB Entry

![Resort style hot tub](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Foundry-lofts-amenities-4.jpg)

## A Breath of Fresh Air

Soak up some sun, relax, and enjoy the view of downtown Ann Arbor. Gather your friends and create lasting memories on our rooftop decks with hot tub, and lounge seating. Or you can relax in our courtyard, equipped with a fire pit, gas grills, and a cabana.

- Rooftop Deck With Hot Tub
- 14th Floor Rooftop Deck
- Grilling Areas
- Outdoor Lounge With Firepit

![Resident clubhouse](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Foundry-lofts-amenities-3.jpg)

## Exclusive Experiences Curated For You

Our modern and spacious sky lounge offers residents a place to gather with roommates and friends for get-togethers, game nights, or watching sporting events.

- Resident Lounge
- 7-Eleven
- 1824 Cocktails & Coffee

![Two young women shopping](https://www.foundryloftsannarbor.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Foundry-lofts-amenities-1.jpg)

## Relax, We've Got You

Dining options are never far from our downtown Ann Arbor apartments. With 7-Eleven and 1824 Cocktails & Coffee located conveniently below our UMich apartments, residents can easily grab a bite to eat or stock up on necessities. Plus, our parking garage is always available to our residents, making life more convenient.

- On-Site Maintenance & Management
- You Speak, We Listen Program
- Community Rewards
- RentPlus Program
- Monthly Resident Events
- Roommate Matching Via RoomSync

\*CLOSED on University Home Football game days
